title: Covered-Mo PDOS: vertical SBH unresolved
conclusion: Finite covered-Mo spectral weight exists at EF; no uniquely resolved vertical band-edge onset or vertical SBH is assigned.
source_calculation: Archived Nanodcal 2021A equilibrium top-contact Au–MoS2–Au; all three SCF metadata entries finish on 2025-09-07, and the checked P DOS log reports calculation finished.

selection.criterion: Mo atoms with 5 < rotated_x_A < 12, using the archived fittedLDOS.py rotation about its lowest-left Mo origin.
selection.origin_definition: Mo atom minimizing x^2+y^2+z^2, as in archived find_llc_atom.
selection.normalization: Arithmetic mean of the five atom-projected Mo DOS values; no Au or S projection, no additional spin multiplier.

units.conversion_check: The native endpoints ±0.0734986519335732 Hartree map to the input ±2 eV; inverse-energy DOS conversion preserves the integrated spectral weight.
units.fermi_reference: mFermiEnergy=[0,0], with both lead voltages zero. NanoDCAL energyRange for systems with leads is measured from the zero-bias lead chemical potential.

processing.fermi_value: Linear interpolation between the two native samples straddling EF (±0.0100502513 eV); this interpolation is used only for EF dot/value.

geometry_caveats: This is the preserved Au dataset explicitly used by dataAnalysis/PLot_For_publication_Au/fittedLDOS.py; not a new DFT calculation.
Original x cell length is 120.641 Angstrom; the archived plotting script uses Lx=108 Angstrom after its in-plane rotation.

F0 to F2 vacancy displacement is 5.484 Angstrom in original x (4.749 Angstrom in the script-rotated coordinate), while final-manuscript lateral distance labels use 2d=6.3 Angstrom. Do not infer those lateral distances from this derivative.
P has 318 atoms and F0/F10 have 316 atoms: each defective raw structure removes two S atoms, one near each contact.
Finite in-gap spectral weight and the native broadening/grid prevent a unique zero-DOS onset; the present figure does not separate broadening tails from physical interface states.
